children.text: ajñātamadhyāntasamudbhavāya sarvātmane sarvagatāya tasmai/
children.translated_text: To that one whose origin, middle, and end are unknown, who is the Self of all, all-pervading —

children.text: praṇamya devāya manobhavāya khalīkṛtaṃ yena jagat samagram//
children.translated_text: having bowed to that god <s>Manobhava</s> (the Mind-born, i.e., Kāma), by whom the entire world has been brought under [his] power —

children.text: prajāpatir manmatha eva yasmāt kāmād vinā na prabhavaḥ prajānām/
children.translated_text: <s>Prajāpati</s> (Lord of Creatures) is indeed <s>Manmatha</s> (the Churner of Hearts), since without <s>kāma</s> (desire), there is no origination of offspring.

children.text: mahatsu sūkṣmeṣu ca so 'sti devaḥ sarvātmakaḥ sarvagataś ca yasmāt//
children.translated_text: That god exists in the great and the subtle, since he is the Self of all and all-pervading.

children.text: yasmāt paran nāparam asti kiñcit saukṣmyān mahatvāc ca yataś ca nānyat/
children.translated_text: Since there is nothing beyond or below him, due to his subtlety and his greatness, and since there is nothing other —

children.text: tenedam ekena manobhavena vyāptaṃ jagac chāṛṅgabhṛteva sarvam//
children.translated_text: by this one <s>Manobhava</s> alone the entire world is pervaded, just as by <s>Śārṅgabhṛt</s> (Viṣṇu, Bearer of the Śārṅga bow).

children.text: agamyagāmī bhagavān prajeśaḥ śroṇīsahasrāṅkatanuś ca śakraḥ/
children.translated_text: <s>Prajeśa</s> (the Lord of Creatures), the Bhagavān who goes to the unapproachable, and <s>Śakra</s> (Indra) whose body is marked with a thousand female organs,

children.text: caturmukho yena kṛtaś ca śambhu samanmatho maṅgalam ādadhātu//
children.translated_text: and <s>Śambhu</s> (Śiva) who was made four-faced — may <s>Manmatha</s> (Kāma) bestow auspiciousness!

children.text: bhagavān api śārṅgarathāṅgadharo bhagavat(t)vam avāpa yataḥ/
children.translated_text: Even the <s>Bhagavān</s> who bears the <s>Śārṅga</s> bow and discus attained his <s>bhagavattva</s> (lordship) from him (Kāma).

children.text: bahavo 'sya bhagā iti tena kṛtaṃ bhagavān iti nāma jagat prathitam//
children.translated_text: Because he has many <s>bhagas</s> (glories/prosperities), therefore the name '<s>Bhagavān</s>' became celebrated in the world.

children.text: sītāviyogena bahuni duḥkhāny āptāni rāmeṇa salakṣmaṇena/
children.translated_text: Many sufferings were endured by <s>Rāma</s> together with <s>Lakṣmaṇa</s> through separation from <s>Sītā</s>.

children.text: tānīha saṃsmṛtya kalau sahasrāṇy aṣṭau tathāṣṭau ca vivāhitāni//
children.translated_text: Remembering those [sufferings] here in the <s>Kali</s> [age], eight thousand and eight marriages were performed.

children.text: durbhagās tanayavarjitāś ca yā niḥsvasanti vanitāḥ pativratā/
children.translated_text: Those faithful wives (<s>pativratā</s>) who are unfortunate, deprived of sons, and who sigh —

children.text: tāḥ kudaivavinipātayantritā nānyajanmajanitaiḥ suduskṛtaiḥ//
children.translated_text: they are bound by the fall of evil fate, [and] by misdeeds generated in other births.

children.text: surabhikusumagandhais tarpayitvā dvijedrān śubhatithidivasarkṣe daivavitsaṃpradiṣṭe/
children.translated_text: Having gratified the best of <s>dvijas</s> (twice-born) with fragrant auspicious flowers, on an auspicious <s>tithi</s> (lunar day), day, and <s>nakṣatra</s> (asterism), as directed by an astrologer,

children.text: ubhayakulaviśuddhe jñātaśīle surūpe prathamavayasi dadyāt kanyakāṃ yauvanasthe//
children.translated_text: when both families are pure, when the character is known, when beauty is present, one should give a maiden in her first youth to a young man of [proper] age.

children.text: puṣye divase 'thavā kṣaṇe vaivāhyeṣu ca bheṣu kārayet/
children.translated_text: On a <s>Puṣya</s> day or at an [auspicious] moment, during marriage-worthy planetary combinations,

children.text: ghaṭakāramṛdā sulakṣaṇām indrāṇīṃ kuśalena śilpinā//
children.translated_text: a skilled artisan should make a well-formed image of <s>Indrāṇī</s> from potter's clay.

children.text: kusumbharaktāmbarabhūṣaṇojjvalāḥ sādhvyaḥ surūpāḥ subhagāḥ kulodbhavāḥ/
children.translated_text: Radiant with safflower-dyed garments and ornaments, virtuous, beautiful, fortunate, born of good family —

children.text: nadīṃ nayeyuḥ saro 'thavā taṭaṃ kanyām alaṅkṛtya sahendra jāyayā//
children.translated_text: the women should lead the adorned maiden, along with the image of <s>Indra</s>'s wife, to a river, a lake, or a bank.

children.text: sūrpeṇadikṣu pramadā baliṃ tā datvā sakālīyakagandhadigdhām/
children.translated_text: Having offered oblations (<s>bali</s>) in the directions with a winnowing basket, the women, [having anointed the image] with <s>kālīyaka</s> sandalwood paste,

children.text: kusumbharaktāmbaraveṣṭitāṅgīṃ śacīsakāśaṃ pramadā nayeyuḥ//
children.translated_text: with limbs wrapped in safflower-dyed cloth, should lead it into the presence of <s>Śacī</s> (Indrāṇī).

children.text: dadhyodanena haviṣā madhunā ca kanyā saṃpūjya śakradayitāṃ ca salohastā [U. salohahastā]/
children.translated_text: Having worshipped <s>Śakra</s>'s beloved (Indrāṇī) with rice cooked in curds (<s>dadhyodana</s>), oblation (<s>havis</s>), and honey, the maiden with iron [bangles] on her hands,

children.text: tūṣṇīṃ praṇamya śirasā gṛham eva yāyād devīṃ pragṛhya muditā niyataiś ca keśaiḥ//
children.translated_text: bowing silently with her head, should joyfully go home, carrying the goddess, with her hair neatly bound.

children.text: gṛhe stitāṃ [U. sthitāṃ] tāṃ puruhūtapatnīṃ prāṅmadhyāstamayeṣu kanyā/
children.translated_text: The maiden should [worship] that wife of <s>Puruhūta</s> (Indra), standing in the house, at sunrise, noon, and sunset,

children.text: sraggandhadhūpaiḥ pratipūjaṇec [U. pratipūjayec] ca pāṇīgrahaṃ yāvad upāgateti//
children.translated_text: with garlands, fragrance, and incense — until the marriage takes place.

children.text: ratnānīndukaraḥ srajaḥ śubhagatā harmyotpalāny āsavaḥ
children.translated_text: Gems, moonbeams, garlands, auspicious [things], mansions, lotuses, liquors,

children.text: tāṃbūlaṃ pravarāmbarāṇi ruciraṃ gītaṃ vibhūtyaś cayā/
children.translated_text: betel, excellent garments, charming song, splendors, and wealth —

children.text: yasmān na striyam antareṇa hi nṛṇāṃ sarvāṇy abhiprītaye
children.translated_text: since without a woman all these do not bring delight to men,

children.text: tasmād vacmi tadāptiyogyasamayo dharmārthakāmāya ca//
children.translated_text: therefore I speak of the proper time for obtaining her, and for <s>dharma</s>, <s>artha</s> (wealth), and <s>kāma</s> (pleasure).

children.text: uktaṃ janmani yat tad eva bhavitā yady aṅganānāṃ phalam/
children.translated_text: Whatever was declared at birth — that alone will be the fruit for women.

children.text: vyartho na tv ayam ādaraṃ pariṇaye tatkālalagnādigaḥ//
children.translated_text: Yet this [attention to marriage timing] is not futile — the <s>lagna</s> (ascendant) etc. at the time of marriage [modifies the result].

children.text: ajñātaṃ prathamaṃ pradhānam aparaṃ tadvyañjakaṃ yoṣitām/
children.translated_text: The first [factor, i.e., prārabdha karma] is unknown, the second is predominant, and that is the indicator for women —

children.text: udvāhe niyati nayaty atibalād velāsamāyuk phalaiḥ//
children.translated_text: in marriage, destiny leads with great force, with fruits matched to the proper time.

children.text: vātsyo varṣam anojam icchati tathā ebhyo janaś cottaraṃ
children.translated_text: <s>Vātsya</s> desires the year and <s>Anoja</s>, and people [desire] more than these.

children.text: strīṇāṃ mānam [U. nāmam] ṛtuṃ vihāya munayo māṇḍavyaśiṣyā jaguḥ/
children.translated_text: The sages, disciples of <s>Māṇḍavya</s>, declared the month (<s>ṛtu</s>) while setting aside the month of women's names.

children.text: caitraṃ projjhya parāśāro kathayate durbhāgyadaṃ yoṣitāṃ
children.translated_text: <s>Parāśara</s>, excluding <s>Caitra</s>, declares it as giving misfortune to women.

children.text: āṣāḍhādicatuṣṭayena śubhadaṃ kaiś cit pradiṣṭaṃ dvijaiḥ//
children.translated_text: Some <s>dvijas</s> (brāhmaṇas) have declared the four [months] beginning with <s>Āṣāḍha</s> as auspicious.

children.text: śreṣṭhaṃ pakṣam uṣanti śuklam asitasyādyaṃ tribhāgaṃ tathā/
children.translated_text: They consider the bright fortnight (<s>śuklapakṣa</s>) as best, and likewise the first third of the dark [fortnight].

children.text: riktāṃ projjhya tithiṃ tathā tv ayanayoḥ sandhiṃ ca śeṣāḥ śubhāḥ//
children.translated_text: Excluding the <s>riktā tithi</s> (empty lunar day) and the junction of the two <s>ayanas</s> (solstices), the rest are auspicious.

children.text: āgneyagrahavāsareṣu kalahaḥ prītis tu satsūttamān [U. satsūttamā]/
children.translated_text: On the days of fiery planets (<s>āgneya graha</s>), there is quarrel; but on the days of benefic [planets], love is supreme.

children.text: kaiścit stharyam uṣanti sauradivase cāndre samāpatnikam//
children.translated_text: Some consider the day of the Sun (<s>saura</s>) as [giving] stability, and the day of the Moon (<s>cāndra</s>) as [producing] a co-wife situation.

children.text: mṛgaśirasi maghāyāṃ hastamitrottarāsu svasananirṛtipūṣādhātṛdeveṣu coḍhā/
children.translated_text: When married under <s>Mṛgaśiras</s>, <s>Maghā</s>, <s>Hasta</s>, <s>Mitra</s> (Anurādhā), the <s>Uttarā</s> [nakṣatras], <s>Svāti</s>, <s>Nirṛti</s> (Mūla), <s>Puṣya</s>, <s>Dhātṛ</s>, or the <s>nakṣatras</s> of the <s>devas</s> —

children.text: bahusutaśukha [U. sukha]dāsīvittasaubhāgyayuktā janayati paritoṣaṃ kanyakā bāndhavānām//
children.translated_text: the maiden, endowed with many sons, happiness, servants, wealth, and good fortune, brings contentment to her relatives.

children.text: ārdrādye bhacatuṣṭaye vidhavatā sāgneyayāmye smṛtā/
children.translated_text: In the four <s>nakṣatras</s> beginning with <s>Ārdrā</s>, widowhood [is predicted]; in the fiery and southern ones, [likewise] it is declared.

children.text: śeṣeṣv akṣayadoṣaśokamaraṇaṃ vyādhyādyaniṣṭaṃ bahuḥ//
children.translated_text: In the remaining ones: imperishable fault, grief, death, disease, and many other inauspicious [results].

children.text: prītir janmasu tārakāsu parataḥ sañjñānurūpaṃ phalam/
children.translated_text: There is love when the birth <s>nakṣatras</s> (stars) [are compatible]; beyond that, fruit is according to the name.

children.text: candre copacayā ''dyasaptamagate saubhāgyasaukhyāptayaḥ//
children.translated_text: And when the Moon is in the 1st or 7th <s>upacaya</s> (increasing) position, there is attainment of good fortune and happiness.

children.text: nakṣatratulyaṃ phalam āha gargaḥ kṣeṇeṣu nakṣatrapasañjñiteṣu
children.translated_text: <s>Garga</s> says the fruit of the <s>nakṣatra</s> is the same in the <s>drekkāṇas</s> (decans) named after <s>nakṣatras</s>.

children.text: hārītababhrū dvijadevalaś ca viṣṭi vinā 'nyat karaṇaṃ praśastam//
children.translated_text: <s>Hārīta</s>, <s>Babhru</s>, and <s>Dvijadeva</s> [say]: except for <s>Viṣṭi</s> [karaṇa], any other <s>karaṇa</s> is praiseworthy.

children.text: tithidinakaraṇarkṣalagnavīryaṃ paricayam āha parāśaraḥ krameṇa/
children.translated_text: <s>Parāśara</s> stated the relative strength in order: <s>tithi</s>, weekday, <s>karaṇa</s>, <s>nakṣatra</s>, and <s>lagna</s> (ascendant).

children.text: tithir iti balabān vadanti gargāḥ karaṇabalād divaso 'pi bhāguriś ca/
children.translated_text: The <s>Gargas</s> say the <s>tithi</s> is the strongest. <s>Bhāguri</s> says the day is [strongest] due to the strength of the <s>karaṇa</s>.

children.text: dinakaraṇabalād bhṛgur bhavīryaṃ balam udayasya jagāda jīvaśarmā//
children.translated_text: <s>Bhṛgu</s> says the <s>nakṣatra</s> is strongest due to the strength of day and <s>karaṇa</s>. <s>Jīvaśarman</s> declared the strength of the rising sign.

children.text: karaṇabhatithayo 'rdhabhuktabhogāḥ svaphalakarā na bhavanti tatra sāmye/
children.translated_text: When <s>karaṇa</s>, <s>nakṣatra</s>, and <s>tithi</s> are half-enjoyed (i.e., partially elapsed), they do not produce their [full] fruits. In that case of equality,

children.text: karaṇatithivāsarodayānāṃ caraṇavivṛtthir anukramāt phalānām//
children.translated_text: the sequential diminution of fruits follows the order of <s>karaṇa</s>, <s>tithi</s>, weekday, and rising sign.

children.text: ṣaṭkāṣṭake maraṇavairaviyogadoṣā dvir dvādaśe nidhanatā 'prajātā trikoṇe/
children.translated_text: In the 6th and 8th [houses], there are faults of death, enmity, and separation; in the 2nd and 12th, death and childlessness; in the <s>trikoṇa</s> (trines),

children.text: prītiḥ parā nigaditā samasaptakeṣu śeṣeṣv anekavidhasaukhyasutārthasaṃpat//
children.translated_text: supreme love is declared; in the same [1st] and 7th, various happiness, sons, wealth, and prosperity.

children.text: ṣaṭkāṣṭake 'pi bhavanādhipam eva bhāva
children.translated_text: Even in the 6th and 8th, one should consider the lordship of the houses.

children.text: ekādhipatyam avalokya ca vaśyarāśim/
children.translated_text: Observing the single lordship and the friendly sign (<s>vaśyarāśi</s>),

children.text: kāryo vivāhasamayaḥ śubhakṛt saduktaḥ
children.translated_text: the marriage time should be made auspicious — as is well-stated —

children.text: stārā [U. tārā] bhaved yadi parasparato 'nukūlā//
children.translated_text: if the stars (<s>tārā</s>) are mutually favorable.

children.text: dāridrayaṃ [U. dāridryaṃ] raviṇā kujena maraṇaṃ saumyena nasyuḥ prajāḥ
children.translated_text: Poverty from the Sun (<s>Ravi</s>); death from Mars (<s>Kuja</s>); from Mercury (<s>Saumya</s>), children perish;

children.text: daurbhāgyaṃ guruṇā sitena sahite candreṇa sāpatnikā/
children.translated_text: misfortune from Jupiter (<s>Guru</s>); when the Moon is with Venus (<s>Sita</s>), there are co-wives.

children.text: pravrajyārkasutena sendujagurau vāñchanti kecit chubham
children.translated_text: Renunciation from Saturn (<s>Arkasuta</s>); when with Jupiter and Mercury, some desire auspiciousness.

children.text: vyādhyair mṛtyur aṇaṃgrahair [U. asaṅgrahair] bahuvidhā dīkṣā pravāsāḥ śubhaiḥ//
children.translated_text: From malefics: diseases, death, various initiations (<s>dīkṣā</s>), journeys abroad; from benefics [other results].

children.text: kriye kumāreṣv anuraktacittā vihīnavittā gavi govratā ca/
children.translated_text: In <s>Meṣa</s> (Aries) [lagna], the mind is attached to young men, deprived of wealth; in <s>Vṛṣabha</s> (Taurus), she observes cow-vows (<s>govratā</s>).

children.text: kuladvayānandakarī tṛtīye kulīralagne kulaṭā nṛśaṃsā//
children.translated_text: In the third [sign, Gemini], she brings joy to both families; in <s>Karkaṭa</s> (Cancer) <s>lagna</s>, she is unchaste (<s>kulaṭā</s>) and cruel.

children.text: harau prasūtā sakṛd āśritā pituḥ patipriyā 'ti śvaśurasya ṣaṣṭhabhe/
children.translated_text: In <s>Hari</s> (Leo), she gives birth once, dependent on her father; beloved of her husband; in the sixth <s>nakṣatra</s> [she is honored by] her father-in-law.

children.text: tulādimānārthavatī tulādhare tathālini krandati nityam asthirā//
children.translated_text: In <s>Tulā</s> (Libra) and beginning [signs], she is endowed with wealth; in <s>Tulā</s> itself, she laments, always unstable.

children.text: dhanuṣi kulaṭā tatpūrvārddhe satīty apare jaguḥ/
children.translated_text: In <s>Dhanus</s> (Sagittarius), she is unchaste — some say in the first half she is faithful.

children.text: mṛgajhaṣaghaṭeṣv anyāśaktā jarām upagacchati//
children.translated_text: In <s>Mṛga</s> (Capricorn), <s>Jhaṣa</s> (Pisces), and <s>Ghaṭa</s> (Aquarius), she is attached to others and approaches old age.

children.text: dvipadabhavanaprāpī yo 'ṃśaḥ sa śubho 'nyagṛhodaye/
children.translated_text: The portion (<s>aṃśa</s>) that reaches a biped sign is auspicious when another's house rises.

children.text: dvipadabhavaneṣv apy anyāṃśā na bhavanti śubhāvahā//
children.translated_text: But in biped signs too, the portions of others do not bring auspiciousness.

children.text: bhānur mṛtyur na bahudhanatāṃ bhartṛdāyād avittaṃ [U. vittaṃ] bandhudhvaṃsaṃ tanayavirahaṃ bhartṛvṛddhiṃ parāṃ ca/
children.translated_text: The Sun [gives, in order from the rising nakṣatra]: death, not much wealth, wealth from husband's inheritance, destruction of kin, separation from sons, great increase of husband, and

children.text: vaidhavyaṃ syān [U. prāk] na laghumaraṇaṃ dharmahāniṃ viśīlaṃ lābhānekān vyayam api dadāty udgamarkṣāt krameṇa//
children.translated_text: widowhood, not early death, loss of <s>dharma</s>, immorality, many gains, and expenditure — in sequence from the rising <s>nakṣatra</s>.

children.text: śaśiny aśvā sārthā tad anu śubhatā bāndhavahitā viputrā bandhyārtā bhavati sasapatnā [U. sapatnā] ''śunidhanā/
children.translated_text: When the Moon [is in successive houses]: horses, caravans, then auspiciousness, kinsmen's welfare, sonlessness, barrenness, affliction, having co-wives, wealth in buffaloes,

children.text: janitrī kanyānām atha vihatakarmā 'tidhaninī vyayāśaktety eke jagur aśubhadā bandhuṣu jale//
children.translated_text: mother of daughters, then obstructed in work, very wealthy, spendthrift — some say — inauspicious among relatives when [the Moon is] in a water [sign].

children.text: mṛtyur naiḥsvaṃ sārthatā bandhuvairaṃ na syuḥ putrā bhartṛvṛddhiṃ kumaitrīm/
children.translated_text: From Mars (<s>Bhauma</s>): death, poverty, caravan-leadership, enmity with kin, no sons, husband's increase, ill-friendedness,

children.text: raktasrāvo nānukulye ca bhartuḥ kravyācchailyaṃ svāptināśaṃ ca bhaume//
children.translated_text: flow of blood, incompatibility with husband, cruelty and savagery, and destruction of one's own [people].

children.text: bhartṛvratā sugṛhiṇī patipakṣapūjyā bandhvarcitā bahusutā vijitāripakṣā/
children.translated_text: From Mercury (<s>Saumya</s>): devoted to husband, a good housewife, honored by husband's family, revered by kin, mother of many sons, with defeated enemies;

children.text: bandhyā vyasur niyamadānakṛśāṅgavittā māyāvatī dhanavatī vyayanīya [U. vyayanī] saumye//
children.translated_text: barren, short-lived, thin-bodied from observances and charity, deceitful, wealthy, and spendthrift.

children.text: patyuḥ priyā 'ti dhaninī muditā dhanyāḍhyā putrānvitā hataparā na sameti bhartā/
children.translated_text: From Jupiter (<s>Jīva</s>): beloved of her husband, very wealthy, joyful, rich in grains, blessed with sons, destroyer of enemies — [but] the husband does not meet [her];

children.text: kṣīṇāyuṣā śubharatā śubhasiddhakāryā svāyānvitā tadubhayopakṛtā ca jīve//
children.translated_text: of short lifespan, delighting in auspiciousness, accomplishing auspicious deeds, endowed with her own [people], benefited by both [planets].

children.text: priyā patyur lubdhā patisahajaśaktā kulahitā
children.translated_text: From Venus (<s>Bhṛgu</s>): dear to her husband, greedy, empowered through partnership with husband, benefiting the family,

children.text: suputrā vairāḍhyā tad anu kulaṭā kṣipranidhanā/
children.translated_text: blessed with good sons, wealthy yet hostile, then unchaste, [meeting] swift death;

children.text: ratā nityaṃ dharme bahukuśalakarmaṇy abhiratā
children.translated_text: always devoted to <s>dharma</s>, delighting in many meritorious deeds,

children.text: bhavaty āyaprāyā kṣapitavibhavā ceti bhṛguṇā//
children.translated_text: mostly income-oriented, with diminished wealth — thus [the results] from Venus.

children.text: puṃścaly asvā bahudhanavatī svalpadugdhārkaputre
children.translated_text: From Saturn (<s>Arkasuta</s>): unchaste, without wealth, [then] very wealthy, with little milk;

children.text: hṛdrogā''rtā vinihataparā garbhavisrāvaśīlā//
children.translated_text: afflicted with heart disease, destroying enemies, prone to miscarriage.

children.text: rogān muktā skhalitaniyamā pāpaśīlā 'tivittā
children.translated_text: Free from diseases, with lapsed observances, of evil conduct, very wealthy;

children.text: pānair arthān nayati vilayaṃ prāvilagnāt krameṇa//
children.translated_text: through drinking she leads wealth to destruction — [these results are] in order from the rising <s>lagna</s>.

children.text: saumyā vyayāstanidhanaṃ tryaribhaṃ ca śukre [U. śukraḥ] hitvā sthitas tridhanalābhagataḥ śaśāṅkaḥ/
children.translated_text: Venus is gentle [when placed] in the 3rd, 6th, 11th, and 8th from [the Moon]; excluding these, the Moon stationed in the 3rd, wealth, and gain houses [is favorable].

children.text: pāpā triṣaḍnidhanalābhagatā vivāhe hitvā 'ṣṭamaṃ kṣitijam iṣṭaphalāni dadyuḥ//
children.translated_text: Malefics in the 3rd, 6th, 8th, and 11th gain houses — in marriage, excluding the 8th, Mars gives desired fruits.

children.text: sutahibukaviyadvilagnadharmeṣv amaragurur yadi dānavārcito vā/
children.translated_text: If <s>Guru</s> (Jupiter), the preceptor of the gods, or [Venus], honored by the <s>dānavas</s> (demons), is in [the houses of] sons, wealth, the mid-heaven, the <s>lagna</s>, or <s>dharma</s> —

children.text: yad aśubham upayāti tac chubhatvaṃ śubham api vṛddhim upaiti tatprabhāvāt//
children.translated_text: That which is inauspicious attains auspiciousness, and what is auspicious also increases in growth, by its influence.

children.text: aniṣṭasthānasaṃstho 'pi praśastaphaladaḥ śaśiḥ/
children.translated_text: Even the Moon stationed in an inauspicious house gives auspicious results,

children.text: saumyabhāge 'dhimitraṇa [U. 'dhimitreṇa] balinā cen nirīkṣtaḥ//
children.translated_text: if it is in the benefic portion, aspected by a strong friendly [planet].

children.text: naragrahabale strīṇāṃ pumān bhavati ballabhaḥ/
children.translated_text: When the strength of a male planet is [dominant] in the horoscope, the man becomes dear (<s>vallabha</s>) to the women.

children.text: viparīte 'ṅganā bhartur arthād anyat prakalpayet//
children.translated_text: In the reverse [case], the wife should arrange for something other than wealth from her husband.

children.text: śukrasūryāstapatiṣu śatrubhe vā tadaṃśake/
children.translated_text: When <s>Śukra</s> (Venus) is combust by the Sun, or [the ascendant is] in the enemy division or its portion,

children.text: virodhamūḍhā yāty āśu śvasruśvasurabhartṛṣu//
children.translated_text: she quickly becomes deluded into conflict with mother-in-law, father-in-law, and husband.

children.text: vilagnāṃśaḥ svanāthena yady udvāhe na dṛśyate/
children.translated_text: If the degree of the ascendant (<s>vilagna</s>) is not aspected by its own lord at the time of marriage,

children.text: puṃvināśas tato 'stāṃśe yady evaṃ yoṣitas tathā//
children.translated_text: there is destruction of the husband; [if] likewise the seventh degree [is unaspected], then the same for the wife.

children.text: gurusitayor uccagayor ekatame vā vilagnage kanyā/
children.translated_text: When <s>Guru</s> (Jupiter) and <s>Sita</s> (Venus) are exalted, or one of them is in the ascendant, the maiden

children.text: rājñi bhavaty asaṃśayam eva gurusaumyayoś coḍhā//
children.translated_text: becomes a queen without doubt. And when <s>Guru</s> (Jupiter) and <s>Saumya</s> (Mercury) are together, the bride [likewise].

children.text: svajāmitrodaye lagne śubhe kāryā caturthikā/
children.translated_text: The fourth-day ceremony (<s>caturthikā</s>) should be performed when the ascendant rises in a friendly or own sign, [and it is] auspicious.

children.text: svavarṇasadṛśā jārās tryādyair ekarkṣasaṃsthitaiḥ//
children.translated_text: Paramours of similar caste [arise] when three or more [malefics] are stationed in a single sign.

children.text: carabhavanagataṃ vihāya satyaḥ śaśinam uvāca śubhapradaṃ vivāhe/
children.translated_text: <s>Satya</s>, leaving aside the Moon placed in a movable sign, declared it auspicious in marriage.

children.text: munivacanavirodhi tac ca sūtre na tu kathite pavanarkṣavaiśvadeve//
children.translated_text: But that contradicts the words of the sages in the <s>sūtra</s>, and it is not stated [for] the wind-<s>nakṣatra</s> and <s>Vaiśvadeva</s>.

children.text: rāśyudgamadvādaśarāśicakre yuktā vivāhā munibhiḥ pradiṣṭā/
children.translated_text: In the zodiac wheel of twelve signs arising from the <s>rāśi</s> (sign), marriages are prescribed by the sages.

children.text: nāmāni cakre grahayogalagne śrīdevakīrtiḥ śṛṇu tasya ca ''ryā//
children.translated_text: The names in the wheel of planet-yoga-ascendant — <s>Śrī Devakīrti</s> [composed them]; hear of them, O noble one!

children.text: nando bhadro jīvo jīmūtaḥ sthāvaro jayo vijayaḥ/
children.translated_text: <s>Nanda</s>, <s>Bhadra</s>, <s>Jīva</s>, <s>Jīmūta</s>, <s>Sthāvara</s>, <s>Jaya</s>, <s>Vijaya</s>,

children.text: vyālo rasātalamukhaḥ kṣayas tamo 'ntyo vivāhagaṇaḥ//
children.translated_text: <s>Vyāla</s>, <s>Rasātalamukha</s>, <s>Kṣaya</s>, <s>Tamas</s> — [these are] the final marriage groupings (<s>vivāhagaṇa</s>).

children.text: saumye vilagne nandaḥ śukre bhadras tathā gurau jīvaḥ/
children.translated_text: When <s>Saumya</s> (Mercury) is in the ascendant, [it is] <s>Nanda</s>; when <s>Śukra</s> (Venus), <s>Bhadra</s>; likewise when <s>Guru</s> (Jupiter), <s>Jīva</s>.

children.text: ādyantau jīmūtaḥ sthāvara iti madhyamāntyābhyām//
children.translated_text: The first and last [produce] <s>Jīmūta</s>; <s>Sthāvara</s> [is produced] by the middle and last [together].

children.text: saumyair atha tair vā ravibhaumaśanaiścaraiḥ kramaśaḥ/
children.translated_text: With those benefics (<s>Saumya</s>), or with the Sun, Mars, and Saturn in order —

children.text: saumyaiḥ jñeyā saumyā krūrāḥ kruraiḥ [U. krūraiḥ] samākhyātā//
children.translated_text: those with benefics should be known as benefic; with malefics, they are declared malefic.

children.text: dinakarayogād vyālo bhaumena rasātalaḥ kṣayaḥ śaninā/
children.translated_text: From conjunction with the Sun, [it is] <s>Vyāla</s>; with Mars (<s>Bhauma</s>), <s>Rasātala</s>; with Saturn (<s>Śani</s>), <s>Kṣaya</s>.

children.text: tamasā tamo nirukto 'thāntye keto [U. ketor] kṛtāntaś ca//
children.translated_text: With [<s>Rāhu</s>], <s>Tamas</s> is declared; and at the end, with <s>Ketu</s>, <s>Kṛtānta</s>.

children.text: triṣu nandādiṣu rājñī caturṣu cātaḥ paraṃ mahādevī/
children.translated_text: In the first three [yogas] beginning with <s>Nanda</s>, [the bride becomes] a queen; in the [next] four after that, a great queen (<s>mahādevī</s>).

children.text: vyālādyeṣu ca pañcaṣu vidhavāḥ śocyā daridrāś ca//
children.translated_text: In the five beginning with <s>Vyāla</s>, [the brides become] widows, pitiable, and destitute.

children.text: anadhikṛtaḥ śubhakṛt syād ete [U. etaiś] candro 'nyathā 'dhikṛtaḥ/
children.translated_text: If not dominated [by malefics], the Moon produces auspicious results; otherwise, if dominated [it produces the opposite].

children.text: tasmāt vivāhasamaye na kena cit saṅgataḥ śaśī dhanyaḥ//
children.translated_text: Therefore, at the time of marriage, the Moon unjoined by any [malefic] is auspicious.

children.text: sapta te śaśiyogā saumyā [U. saumyaiḥ] saha sarvakarmasiddhikarāḥ/
children.translated_text: These seven lunar yogas, together with benefics, produce success in all actions.

children.text: aśubhaphaladās tu pāpaiḥ patyudvahane vivarjyās te//
children.translated_text: But with malefics, they give inauspicious results — they should be avoided in marriage.

children.text: tasmād etān yogān matimāṃ[sic.] sañcivtya [U. yuñjīta] sarvakāryeṣu/
children.translated_text: Therefore, the wise person, having reflected upon these yogas, should employ [them] in all undertakings.

children.text: ūḍhā nande kanyā devīśabdaṃ samāpnuyād acirāt//
children.translated_text: A maiden married in [the yoga] <s>Nanda</s> attains the title of queen (<s>devī</s>) quickly.

children.text: bhavati narendrajananī bhartuḥ prāṇaiḥ priyā caiva/
children.translated_text: She becomes the mother of a king and dearer than life to her husband.

children.text: bhadre pāṇigrahaṇe yadi nāma kumārikā samupayāti//
children.translated_text: If indeed a maiden is married in [the yoga] <s>Bhadra</s>,

children.text: sā tvaritān nṛpaśabdaṃ karoti bhārtuḥ kulasyāpi/
children.translated_text: she quickly brings the title of king to her husband and his family.

children.text: pariṇītā jīvākhye kanyā vijayāya kīrtyate bhartuḥ//
children.translated_text: A maiden married in the [yoga] called <s>Jīva</s> is celebrated for the victory of her husband.

children.text: prāpnoti sā trivargaṃ kuladvayaṃ cāpi nandayati/
children.translated_text: She attains the triple pursuit (<s>trivarga</s>) and delights both families.

children.text: jīmūte pariṇītā vipulān bhogān mahāphalān bhuktvā//
children.translated_text: A maiden married in [the yoga] <s>Jīmūta</s>, having enjoyed vast pleasures of great fruit,

children.text: dṛṣdvā ca naptṛtanayān sahabhartā devatvam/
children.translated_text: and having seen grandchildren and sons, attains divine status together with her husband.

children.text: sthāvarayoge kanyā pāṇigraham etya vipulam aiśvaryam//
children.translated_text: In the yoga <s>Sthāvara</s>, a maiden, having entered into marriage, [attains] vast sovereignty (<s>aiśvarya</s>).

children.text: bhartur nidhānalābhān prāpya kulasyonnatiṃ kurute/
children.translated_text: Having obtained her husband's hidden treasures, she brings elevation to the family.

children.text: pāṇigraham etya jaye jaghanyakulajāpi bhartur aiśvaryam//
children.translated_text: Having entered into marriage in [the yoga] <s>Jaya</s>, even one born of a low family [brings] her husband's sovereignty.

children.text: āvahati sadā kanyā niṣevyamānā sapatnībhiḥ/
children.translated_text: The maiden always brings [prosperity], attended upon by co-wives.

children.text: vijayāṃ prāpyodvāhaṃ prāpnoti sutān yaśo 'rthalābhaṃ ca//
children.translated_text: Having obtained marriage in [the yoga] <s>Vijaya</s>, she obtains sons, fame, and gain of wealth,

children.text: vaṃśasya ca pratiṣṭhāṃ parato maraṇāc ca suralokam/
children.translated_text: and the establishment of the lineage, and after death, the world of the gods.

children.text: vyāle vyālākārā pāṇigraham eti kanyakā daivāt//
children.translated_text: In [the yoga] <s>Vyāla</s>, a maiden enters marriage by fate, serpent-like in form,

children.text: dāridryāmayayuktā naikasmin puṃsi sā ramate/
children.translated_text: afflicted with poverty and disease — she does not delight in a single man.

children.text: pātālanāmani gatā pāṇigrahaṇe ca pañcamān māsāt//
children.translated_text: When [marriage] occurs in [the yoga] named <s>Pātāla</s>, from the fifth month after the marriage ceremony,

children.text: sā prāpya doṣam atulaṃ paraḥ prāṇān parityajati/
children.translated_text: she, having attained unbearable fault, gives up her life thereafter.

children.text: kṣayam āsādyodvāhaṃ kanyā pakṣadvayāt patiṃ hatvā//
children.translated_text: Having obtained marriage in [the yoga] <s>Kṣaya</s>, the maiden, within two fortnights, having killed her husband,

children.text: nīcena tu saha bhartrā kṣapayati jārāgninā gotram/
children.translated_text: together with a lowly [man] as her husband, she destroys the lineage by the fire of her paramour.

children.text: pāṇigrahas tamasi cel lakṣaṇaguṇavittato 'pi sampannā//
children.translated_text: If the marriage takes place in [the yoga] <s>Tamas</s>, even if she is endowed with [good] marks, qualities, and wealth,

children.text: saptati rātrāt kṣapayati yady api jātā surendreṇa/
children.translated_text: within seventy nights she destroys [all] — even if born through <s>Indra</s> himself.

children.text: yadi khalu kṛtāntayoge pariṇayam āyati kanyakā daivāt//
children.translated_text: If indeed in the yoga of <s>Kṛtānta</s> (Death), a maiden enters marriage by fate,

children.text: sā śvasurabandhuvargaṃ kṣapayaty acireṇa kālena/
children.translated_text: she destroys the father-in-law's family and relatives in a short time.

children.text: ātmopekṣakapoṣakavadhakā iti rāśayo 'rthato 'bhihitaḥ//
children.translated_text: 'Self,' 'indifferent,' 'nourishing,' and 'killing' — thus the <s>rāśis</s> (signs) are designated by meaning.

children.text: ebhyaḥ śubham aśubhaṃ vā nirdeśyā janmalagnābhyām/
children.translated_text: From these, auspicious or inauspicious [results] should be declared from the birth and ascendant [signs].

children.text: ātmeti janmalagnaṃ pañcama navamaṃ ca kīrtitaṃ tasmāt//
children.translated_text: 'Self' is declared to be the birth-ascendant, the fifth, and the ninth — therefore,

children.text: dviṣaṭkadaśamabhavanam upekṣakākhyaṃ vinirdiṣṭam//
children.translated_text: the second, sixth, and tenth house is designated as the 'indifferent' [house].

children.text: duścikyaṃ jāmitraṃ caikādaśakaṃ ca poṣakaṃ jñeyam//
children.translated_text: The third, seventh (<s>jāmitra</s>), and eleventh are to be known as 'nourishing.'

children.text: dvādaśanidhanacaturthaṃ vadhakākhyaṃ śāstranirdiṣṭam/
children.translated_text: The twelfth, eighth (<s>nidhana</s>), and fourth are designated as 'killing,' as taught by the <s>śāstra</s>.

children.text: hitvā śaśāṅkaṃ yadi sapta saumyaiḥ pañcāśubhaiḥ kiṃ kathitā na saptā//
children.translated_text: Leaving aside the Moon, if seven [yogas] are with benefics, five with malefics — why are the seven not [separately] stated?

children.text: dvitryādiyogān parihṛtya kasmān noktaṃ śataṃ trighanaṃ vilagne/
children.translated_text: Setting aside the yogas of two, three, etc., why are the 343 combinations not stated in the ascendant?

children.text: deśācāras tāvad ādau vicintyo deśe deśe yā sthiti saiva kāryā//
children.translated_text: The customs of the region (<s>deśācāra</s>) should first be considered; in each region, whatever is the established practice, that alone should be followed.

children.text: lokadviṣṭāṃ paṇḍitā varjayanti daivajño 'pi lokamārgeṇa yāyāt/
children.translated_text: The wise avoid what is hated by the people. Even an astrologer (<s>daivajña</s>) should follow the ways of the world.

children.text: bṛhaspatau gocaraśobhanasthe vivāham icchanti ca dakṣiṇātyāḥ/
children.translated_text: The southerners (<s>Dakṣiṇātya</s>) desire marriage when <s>Bṛhaspati</s> (Jupiter) is well-placed in transit (<s>gocara</s>).

children.text: ravau śubhasthe ca vadanti gauḍā na gocaro mālavake pramāṇam//
children.translated_text: The <s>Gauḍas</s> (easterners) declare [it auspicious] when the Sun is well-placed. In <s>Mālava</s>, transit is not the authority.

children.text: harau prasupte na ca dakṣiṇāyane na caitramāse na ca puṣyasaṃjñite/
children.translated_text: When <s>Hari</s> (Jupiter) is dormant, nor in the southern solstice (<s>dakṣiṇāyana</s>), nor in the month of <s>Caitra</s>, nor in [the month] called <s>Puṣya</s>,

children.text: tithau ca rikte śaśini kṣayaṅgate ravīndubhaumārkidineṣu cāśubham//
children.translated_text: nor on a <s>rikta tithi</s> (empty lunar day), when the Moon is waning — on the days of the Sun, Moon, Mars, and Saturn, [it is] inauspicious.

children.text: vyatipātahataṃ dinatrayaṃ vyatipātena samaṃ ca vaidhṛtim//
children.translated_text: Three days are afflicted by <s>Vyatīpāta</s>, and <s>Vaidhṛti</s> is equal to <s>Vyatīpāta</s>.

children.text: tad api sphuṭapātadarśane dviguṇaṃ yadi vā na niścitam/
children.translated_text: But that too, in the observation of the exact <s>pāta</s> (fall), is doubled; or else it is not certain.

children.text: vyatipātavyāghātaḥ ṣaṣṭhe daśame ca vaidhṛtaṃ dhiṣṇye//
children.translated_text: <s>Vyatīpāta</s>-<s>vyāghāta</s> [occurs] in the sixth and tenth <s>nakṣatra</s>; <s>Vaidhṛti</s> [occurs in that] <s>nakṣatra</s>.

children.text: vikṣobhaṇagaṇḍāntāv atidhṛtisaṃkhye ca vyāghātaḥ/
children.translated_text: <s>Vikṣobhaṇa</s> (agitation) and <s>gaṇḍānta</s> (junction-end) [occur] at the <s>atidhṛti</s> number, and <s>vyāghāta</s> [also].

children.text: tad idaṃ vyatipātaṃ ca kathayanti uttaradiksthitājanāḥ//
children.translated_text: This <s>vyatīpāta</s> is taught by the people dwelling in the northern direction.

children.text: vyatipātavad ākulasthitaṃ bahusiddhāntaviśeṣakāraṇe/
children.translated_text: Like <s>vyatīpāta</s>, it is considered disturbed, due to the differences of many <s>siddhāntas</s> (astronomical systems).

children.text: tathottarāḥ sākalasannikṛṣṭā māṇḍavyamātīyatusārddhakeṣu//
children.translated_text: Likewise the northerners, close to <s>Sākala</s>, [follow] the [traditions] of <s>Māṇḍavya</s>, <s>Mātīya</s>, and <s>Tuṣārdha</s>.

children.text: khaśeṣu hūṇeṣu na bāhlikeṣu vā na, kāṇadeśeṣu na gopabhojāḥ/
children.translated_text: Among the <s>Khaśas</s>, <s>Hūṇas</s>, and <s>Bāhlikas</s>, nor in <s>Kāṇadeśa</s>, nor the <s>Gopa-Bhojas</s> —

children.text: ekādaśoktāni śubhāni bhāni śeṣāṇy aniṣṭāni vivāhakāle//
children.translated_text: eleven <s>nakṣatras</s> are declared auspicious; the remainder are inauspicious at the time of marriage.

children.text: tatrāgni [U. tatrāpi] tārā śaśivīryayuktā triṃśan muhūrtāś ca vicintanīyāḥ/
children.translated_text: Therein, the <s>Agni</s>-star (<s>Kṛttikā</s>) endowed with the Moon's strength — and thirty <s>muhūrtas</s> are to be considered.

children.text: tulādharastrīmithunād vivāha [U. vihāya] lagne sthitā pāpaphalā na cānye//
children.translated_text: From [the ascendants of] Libra (<s>Tulā</s>), Aquarius (<s>Dhara</s>), Virgo (<s>Strī</s>), and Gemini (<s>Mithuna</s>), the marriage ascendant produces inauspicious results, and not others.

children.text: triṃśāṃśakadvādaśabhāgabhedair dreṣkāṇahorāpramukhair vicintyaḥ/
children.translated_text: They should be examined by the divisions of the thirtieth part (<s>triṃśāṃśa</s>), twelfth part (<s>dvādaśabhāga</s>), <s>dreṣkāṇa</s>, <s>horā</s>, and other [sub-divisions].

children.text: māse nāṣṭāu viṣṭiduṣṭāni bhāni tatrāpy eke rātrim āhur dinaṃ ca//
children.translated_text: In a month, eight <s>nakṣatras</s> are corrupted by <s>viṣṭi</s> (<s>bhadrā karaṇa</s>); therein, some say [it applies to] the night and day [separately].

children.text: tithyarddhe 'ntye prāptināśau ca viṣṭe [U. viṣṭeḥ] cāndraṃ mānaṃ viṣṭihetu na śeṣam/
children.translated_text: At the end of the half-<s>tithi</s>, attainment and loss [occur] through <s>viṣṭi</s>. The lunar measure is the cause of <s>viṣṭi</s>, not the rest.

children.text: prācyāḥ prāyoḥ nyūnavarṇāḥ sagopāḥ saṃdhyākālaṃ prāhur iṣṭaṃ na śeṣam//
children.translated_text: The easterners, mostly of lesser caste, with cowherds, declare the twilight time (<s>saṃdhyākāla</s>) auspicious, not the rest.

children.text: yāvac chāntaṃ gorajo nābhyupeti tāvat teṣāṃ cittaśuddhir vivāhe/
children.translated_text: As long as the cow-dust has not yet arisen in peace, for that long their purity of mind [prevails] in marriage.

children.text: gopair yaṣṭayāhatānāṃ [U. yaṣṭyāhatānāṃ] khurapuṭadalitā yā tu dhūlir dinānte
children.translated_text: The dust trampled by the hooves [of cattle], struck by the sticks of cowherds, at the end of the day —

children.text: sodvāhe sundarīṇāṃ vipuladhanasutāś cāyurārogyasaṃpat//
children.translated_text: at that [time], the marriage of beautiful women [brings] abundant wealth, sons, longevity, health, and prosperity.

children.text: tasmin kāle na ca rkṣaṃ na ca tithikaraṇaṃ naiva lagnaṃ na yogaḥ
children.translated_text: At that time, neither the <s>nakṣatra</s>, nor the <s>tithi</s> and <s>karaṇa</s>, nor the ascendant (<s>lagna</s>), nor the <s>yoga</s> [matter].

children.text: khyātaḥ puṃsāṃ sukhārthaṃ śamayati duritāni utthitaṃ gorajas tu/
children.translated_text: It is proclaimed that, for the happiness of men, the risen cow-dust destroys evils.

children.text: kulasya deśasya ca cittavṛttir na khaṇḍaniyā [U. khaṇḍanīyā] viduṣā kadācit//
children.translated_text: The disposition of the family and region should never be contradicted by the learned.

children.text: dosaḥ pratisyāyakṛto 'pi yo 'tra saṃbhāvyate jyautiṣikasya so 'jñaiḥ/
children.translated_text: Whatever fault is imagined here by the ignorant, [it is like] that caused by a cold — [and is attributed] to the astrologer.

children.text: śāstraśarīram abudhvā bahudhā jalpanti yady api nānumatam//
children.translated_text: Without understanding the body of the <s>śāstra</s>, they babble in many ways, even though [it is] not approved.

children.text: kāṇānāṃ viṣayagataḥ prājño nimilayen netram/
children.translated_text: The wise person, having entered the domain of the blind, should close his eyes.

children.text: evaṃ vivāhasamaye gamane praveśe kāryeṣu maṅgalayuteṣv athavā pareṣu//
children.translated_text: Thus, at the time of marriage, at departure, at entry, in auspicious undertakings, or in others,

children.text: doṣaṃ kuśikṣitakudaivavido vadanti rāgeṇa vā paṭudhiyo namo 'stu tebhyaḥ/
children.translated_text: the poorly-trained, bad-fate-knowers declare [it] a fault — whether through passion or sharp intellect — salutations to them!

children.text: gocaraśuddhāv induṃ kanyāyā yatnataḥ śubhaṃ vīkṣya//
children.translated_text: In the purification of transit (<s>gocara</s>), one should carefully examine the Moon as auspicious for the bride.

children.text: tigmakiraṇaś ca puṃsaḥ śeṣair avarṇair api vivāhaḥ/
children.translated_text: And the Sun (<s>Tigmakiraṇa</s>) for the groom — even with other unfavorable [factors], the marriage [may proceed].

children.text: na sakalaguṇasaṃpal labhyate 'lpair ahobhir bahutaraguṇayogaṃ yojayet maṅgaleṣu//
children.translated_text: A complete collection of all qualities cannot be obtained in a few days; one should combine the maximum number of qualities in auspicious [ceremonies].

children.text: prabhavati na hi doṣo bhūribhāve guṇānāṃ salilalava ivāgneḥ saṃpradīptendhanasya/
children.translated_text: For a fault does not prevail when there is an abundance of virtues — like a drop of water upon a blazing fire with fuel kindled.

children.text: guṇaśatam api doṣaḥ kaścid eko 'pi vṛddhaḥ kṣapayati yadi nānyat tadvirodhiguṇo 'sti/
children.translated_text: Even a hundred virtues are destroyed by a single great fault, if there is no opposing virtue.

children.text: ghaṭam api paripūrṇaṃ pañcagavyasya śaktyā malinayati surāyā bindur eko 'pi sarvam//
children.translated_text: Even a pot completely full of <s>pañcagavya</s> (five cow-products) is entirely defiled by a single drop of liquor.

children.text: kṛtakautukamaṅgalo varo madhuparkādyaśanād anantaram//
children.translated_text: The groom, having performed the <s>kautuka-maṅgala</s> (auspicious thread-tying) ceremony, immediately after consuming the <s>madhuparka</s> (honey-offering) and other foods,

children.text: jvalitāgnisamakṣamaṅgalaṃ yad avāpnoti śubhāśubhaṃ ca tam//
children.translated_text: whatever auspicious and inauspicious [result] he obtains — that is [determined by] the auspicious ceremony [performed] before the blazing fire.

children.text: cakre varāhamihiraḥ praṇipatya sādhūn samyak vivāhapaṭalaṃ pṛthutāṃ vihāya/
children.translated_text: <s>Varāhamihira</s>, having bowed to the sages, composed the <s>Vivāhapaṭala</s> (Chapter on Marriage) properly, setting aside prolixity.

children.text: pūrvaṃ ca yad yuvatijanmavidhau mayoktaṃ saṃcintya tac ca sadasatparikalpanīyam//
children.translated_text: And what was previously stated by me regarding the rules for a young woman's nativity (<s>yuvatijanmavidhi</s>), having reflected upon that, it should be considered as [either] valid or invalid [according to context].
